description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable cysteine-type endopeptidase activity and thiol-dependent deubiquitinase. Predicted to be involved in G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle and protein deubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Deubiquitinating enzyme that cleaves ubiquitin from target proteins, opposing ubiquitin-mediated regulation, including proteasomal degradation and non-proteolytic signaling. Deubiquitinates and stabilizes TP53 in response to oxidative stress, promoting TP53 accumulation and apoptosis (PubMed:21285945). Involved in innate antiviral immunity by mediating 'Lys-48'-linked deubiquitination of CGAS, thereby promoting its stabilization (PubMed:32457395). Deubiquitinates and stabilizes the S-phase checkpoint adapter CLSPN/Claspin, counteracting SCF(beta-TrCP)-mediated degradation and thereby contributing to checkpoint control and recovery (PubMed:24632611). Deubiquitinates and stabilizes the histone methyltransferase SETD8/KMT5A, controlling DNA-damage-induced H4K20 monomethylation and TP53BP1 focus formation, and so maintaining genome stability (PubMed:36010569). Acts as a negative regulator of cardiac hypertrophy by directly interacting with and removing 'Lys-63'-linked ubiquitin from TAK1/MAP3K7, suppressing TAK1 activation and the downstream hypertrophic program (PubMed:40040611). (Microbial infection) Enhances SARS-CoV-2 ORF9b-mediated type I IFN and NF-kappa-B inhibition by preventing its degradation by ubiquitination.
